title: Party Appearances
guidance: Personal appearances of parties, including expressly stated remote appearances. Representation by counsel alone does not establish personal attendance.

title: Evidence Considered
guidance: Evidence, reports, exhibits, records, stipulations, and evidentiary rulings the court considered. Distinguish argument from evidence.

title: Testimony
guidance: Material sworn testimony and the witnesses giving it. Q/A formatting alone does not establish sworn testimony.

title: Disputed Issues
guidance: Material contested legal, factual, or procedural questions argued or decided; omit routine uncontested scheduling.

title: Party Positions and Reasons
guidance: Attribute each material position and its stated reasons to the party taking it. Do not invent unstated positions.

title: Court Findings/Orders and Reasons
guidance: Material findings and orders actually made, with their stated reasons. Distinguish requested relief from rulings.
